svg.title: LLM roles in the AI PM Copilot
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing three model roles: a reasoning model for orchestration and complex tasks, a code model for generation and review, and an embedding model for semantic search.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What reasoning tasks does Claude handle in the copilot?')
sendPrompt('What language tasks does the reasoning model handle?')
sendPrompt('What decisions does the reasoning model make in the copilot?')
sendPrompt('What code generation tasks does the code model handle?')
sendPrompt('How does the code model assist with PR review?')
sendPrompt('What security and dependency checks does the code model do?')
sendPrompt('How does the embedding model encode project memories?')
sendPrompt('How does the embedding model power semantic search?')
sendPrompt('What does the embedding model do for code similarity?')
